Questions about this page

Is this the final Orb privacy policy?
No. The approved policy is awaiting publication. The explanations on this page are not a substitute for the final policy.
Can I send a report or a privacy request here?
No. This page has no report-upload or request-submission form. The authorized data-request route is listed separately when available.
Where can I find the terms of use?
The Terms of use page shows the current publication status. Its approved document is separate from the privacy policy.
